name: io.github.proprock/jira-mini-mcp
title: jira-mini-mcp
description: Minimal Jira Cloud MCP server: broad reads, a narrow 3-tool write surface, optional read-only mode.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Jira Cloud site, e.g. https://example.atlassian.net

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: The email your Jira API token belongs to

environmentVariables.name: READ_ONLY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true, 1, or on to register only the six read tools and withhold the three write tools
